description: This is a Java test class for the BlockNamespace component within a signals/commands/namespaces context of the Eclipse Ditto project. It primarily contains unit tests validating the behavior, immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality methods of the BlockNamespace class.

classes.name: BlockNamespaceTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the BlockNamespace class, including immutability, equality, serialization, and deserialization.

methods.name: initTestConstants
methods.description: Initializes static test constants before all tests execute.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each individual test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Validates that the BlockNamespace class instances are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals methods for BlockNamespace.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that creating a BlockNamespace from JSON produces the expected object.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Validates that the toJson method of BlockNamespace returns the expected JSON.

methods.name: getIdReturnsNamespace
methods.description: Ensures getId() returns the same value as getNamespace().

methods.name: getEntityIdReturnsNamespace
methods.description: Checks that getEntityId().toString() returns the namespace string.

methods.name: toStringContainsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the string representation of the object includes class name and namespace.
